data.display_address: Palace Residences 1, Palace Residences at Hills Estate, Dubai Hills Estate, Dubai
data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate LLC is delighted to present this exceptional 2 bedroom apartment with open community views, ideally located in Building 1 of the prestigious Palace Residences, Dubai Hills Estate.

This property offers a perfect blend of luxury, style, comfort, and prime location — an excellent opportunity for both end-users and investors.

Property Features:

- 2 Spacious Bedrooms
- 2 Modern Bathrooms
- Corner Unit
- Large and Spacious Layout
- Bright and Open Living Area
- Floor-to-Ceiling Windows
- Luxury Finishes
- High-Quality Features
- Private Balcony with Lagoon and Villas View
- Allocated Parking Space
- Fully Equipped Kitchen
- Palace Hotel Style Branding

Community Highlights:

- Direct Access to Dubai Hills Park
- Closest Bulding to Dubai Hills Mall
- Opposite to Dubai Hills Business Park
- 24/7 Security and Concierge Services
- World-Class Amenities including Pools, Gym, and Landscaped Gardens

Palace Residences offers the perfect balance of vibrant city life and serene green spaces. Residents enjoy direct access to Dubai Hills Park, brimming with lifestyle amenities, and are just moments away from Dubai Hills Mall — a premier hub for retail and entertainment. With exceptional dining options at the nearby Dubai Hills Business Park, this address places you at the center of luxury, leisure, and urban energy.
